newsitem.title: USA: ASARCO sees turnaround in lead/zinc business.
newsitem.headline: ASARCO sees turnaround in lead/zinc business.

text.p: ASARCO, the U.S. base metals company, said its lead and zinc business was expected to become profitable over the next two years following this year's losses to date.

"We project that in the next couple of years we expect to be profitable as we exist today," Robert Novotny, ASARCO's vice president, lead, zinc, silver and mineral operations, told an analysts briefing on Friday.
